actual: 澄清后追问曾出现静默无回复；agentic 循环选到 manifest 只读但 capability 未覆盖的工具（如 aistock-local-data/local_data_get_unack_alert_count）时，_capability_key_for_tool 抛 KeyError 并让 chat/turn 404/崩溃。数据源读取异常也可能被上层 insufficient evidence 掩盖。
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
chat/turn returns HTTP 200 with explicit structured error details for capability_not_found/tool_execution_error/data_source_unavailable.
Clarification follow-up always yields a non-empty assistant reply or explicit concrete error.
Real tool/program/data-source errors are distinguishable from insufficient evidence and logged.
description: 更正范围：Research Assistant 对话轮在两类情形下必须保持 no-silent-error：一是澄清后追问不得静默无回复；二是 agentic 工具/能力解析或执行报错不得让 chat/turn 以 4xx/5xx 崩溃。真实程序错误、能力未覆盖或数据源不可访问必须在本轮 HTTP 200 回复中以可定位方式显式上报，包含 reason_code、server_key/tool_name、异常类型和原始错误摘要；不得把真实错误软化为笼统话术，也不得用 insufficient evidence 掩盖。Insufficient evidence 仅用于证据确实不足。约束：不启/重启 8001/3000/19080，不碰生产 DB，无 DDL。

events.note: Revised BUG-404 scope per user: no silent/no crash for clarification follow-up plus explicit concrete reporting for tool/capability/data-source failures; scope expanded to RA service/react loop/execution references and related tests; production gates remain noop.

expected: 任意 chat/turn 都返回非空助手消息；单个工具/能力/数据源失败不炸整轮，而是在回复和卡片中明确包含 reason_code、工具标识、异常类型与原始错误摘要，并记录日志/事件。真实错误不得呈现为 insufficient evidence；只有证据确实不足时才使用 insufficient。
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
Do not start or restart production runtime services 8001/3000/19080.
Do not touch production DB or apply DDL.
Do not soften real tool/program errors into insufficient evidence.
title: RA chat turns never crash or go silent on clarification follow-up and tool/capability failures

recommendations: Use compact success output; request full JSON only for failures or diagnostics.
Run targeted validation first, then final gates once the patch is stable.
